purpose: Cheap signal-level gate before historical options-spread replay.

proxyDefinitions.rates: TLT 5-minute bars; falling TLT confirms bearish/rising-rate impulse and rising TLT confirms bullish/falling-rate impulse.
proxyDefinitions.nasdaqRelative: QQQ return from session open relative to SPY return from session open.
proxyDefinitions.breadth: RSP return from session open used as an equal-weight breadth proxy; same directional sign as candidate.
proxyDefinitions.vwap: SPY cumulative intraday VWAP computed from bar volume and bar VWAP/typical price.

confirmations: QQQ return from open >= SPY return from open
current SPY bar volume >= average volume of prior 6 bars
QQQ return from open <= SPY return from open
current SPY bar volume >= average volume of prior 6 bars

bootstrapGate.note: Advance means eligible for options-history replay, not proven edge.
